seoTitle: Cooking Converter: Cups to Grams for Flour, Sugar and More
metaDescription: Convert cups, tablespoons, teaspoons, mL, grams and ounces for common ingredients using typical weights per cup.
intro: Converts between cups, spoons, millilitres, grams and ounces for 17 baking ingredients, using typical grams per US cup.
why:
A cup of flour and a cup of sugar weigh different amounts, so cups to grams depends on the ingredient. Flour is about 120 g a cup, granulated sugar about 198 g.

Values come from the King Arthur Baking ingredient weight chart (read 2026-10-23). Scooping and packing change real weight, so use a scale for baking.
howTo: Enter the amount and its unit.

faq.q: How many grams is a cup of flour?
faq.a: 120 g here, from the King Arthur chart. Other sources say 125 to 140 g.

faq.q: Why do results differ from my recipe?
faq.a: Packing, sifting and brand change the weight. Trust the recipe weight first.
Yes, a US tablespoon is 14.79 mL and a teaspoon 4.93 mL.
